capabilities.purpose: Turn a vague business, product or process problem into an evidenced decision frame: quick brief, causal why-tree, or full SCQA, why tree, MECE issue map, customer/process causal map, measurable hypothesis and one-page draft PRD. Not for known code bugs.

Hermes workflow adapted from the PM Skills discover command: new/existing branch, ideas, assumption register, impact x uncertainty ranking, experiment plan and recommended next decision, with explicit checkpoints.

Convert an accepted problem, discovery result or feature brief into a lean PRD: target users, problem/value, goals and metrics, functional requirements, non-goals, constraints, risks, testable acceptance criteria and an implementation handoff. Never edits source.
Adapted gstack office-hours: interrogate demand, users and alternatives to produce an opportunity brief with open decisions; skips questions whose answers are already in accepted artifacts.
Adapted gstack spec: turn intent into a scoped local spec with acceptance tests and a task handoff. Issue filing is an external write that needs exact approval.
Adapted gstack plan-eng-review checklists: architecture, failure modes, test plan and delivery risks recorded as an engineering review/ADR feeding the existing engineering path.
Adapted gstack plan-design-review: information architecture, journeys, interaction-state coverage, accessibility risks and unresolved design decisions for a plan, before implementation.

Adapted gstack design-consultation: design brief, user journey, semantic tokens, interaction states, responsive behavior, accessibility requirements and a preview artifact, with asset rights recorded.
gstack review checklists applied as an independent, input-bound audit through the existing restricted review path; fix-first behavior is split out to the existing coordinator writer.
Adapted gstack qa audit half: functional QA charter for site/API/CLI with reproduced bugs and evidence; repairs go to the existing writer, never from this capability.

Adapted gstack design-review audit half: visual consistency, missing states, responsiveness, accessibility, usability and design-system consistency of actual artifacts; read-only, no coding permission.

Adapted PM Skills competitive-analysis: cited, dated competitor comparison, feature and pricing findings, market assumptions, positioning, opportunities, risks and recommendations; observed facts separated from estimates.
(planned, not implemented) Adapted PM Skills positioning-ideas: differentiated positioning alternatives with evidence, feeding the existing marketing team recipe.

(planned, not implemented) Original workflow: process diagnosis from approved baseline data, at least two alternatives with control risks, and a bounded measurable pilot plan; improvement is claimed only from actual pilot data.

The shipped coordinator engineering loop: reproduce and investigate, sole Claude coding route fix, real regression tests, independent review and approved feature-branch handoff, with exact-SHA platform lanes when needed. Bugs and typos go here directly.

The shipped marketing recipe (research, positioning, channel plan, strategy review) using the existing marketing profile; produces an actionable marketing plan. Publishing and spend stay separately approved.

guidance: Decide whether a new product idea is worth pursuing: kit.problem-definition, pm.product-discovery, pm.competitor-research
Turn an accepted feature into requirements and an engineering plan review: pm.lean-prd, gstack.plan-eng-review
Fix a known coding bug or typo: existing.engineering-path
Improve an existing user interface: gstack.design-review, existing.engineering-path, gstack.qa
Compare competitors from public sources: pm.competitor-research
Produce an actionable marketing plan: existing.marketing-team
Diagnose a business process and plan a measurable pilot: kit.operational-analysis
